title: Windshield Frame Land and Outboard Doubler — Crack Repair

issue.reason: Original issue of the windshield frame land and outboard doubler crack repair.

abstract: Permanent repair for a crack in the windshield frame land or the outboard doubler at the lower forward corner, using an external doubler and a revised fastener pattern that clears the heater terminal.

sections.purpose: To give the permanent repair for a crack found in the windshield frame land or in the outboard doubler at the lower forward corner of a windshield aperture.
sections.damage_assessment: Cracking at this location starts at a fastener hole in the lower forward corner and runs inboard along the land. It is found at pane replacement rather than in service, because the area is covered by the pane and the trim. The heater terminal on the delivered standard sits directly in this corner and the local heat is a contributing factor; on aircraft at the relocated terminal standard the incidence is lower but the repair is the same. Assess the damage with the pane removed and the land cleaned. Measure the crack length from the hole edge. Do an eddy current inspection at every fastener hole in the corner group before deciding the repair, because a second crack at an adjacent hole changes the repair from local to full corner.
sections.repair_procedure: Remove the pane under the removal task and record the shim values. Remove the outboard doubler ARD967927-47 by drilling out the blind rivets to the depth on the drawing. Clean the land and remove the paint over the corner group. Do an eddy current inspection at every fastener hole in the group and mark every indication. Stop-drill the crack at its tip with the drill size on the drawing and deburr both faces. Where the crack runs from a hole, ream the hole to the first oversize and install a bushed insert to the drawing. Cut the repair doubler from the material listed and form it to the corner radius on the forming block. Position the doubler over the repaired area with the 20 mm minimum edge margin and drill the new pattern through into the land. Do an eddy current inspection at every new hole before any fastener is installed. Install the doubler D5610001982294 wet with sealant using tension bolts AES273284K7 at the structural row and blind rivets AES757493-5D at the outer row. Re-protect the whole area. Install the outboard doubler and the pane, setting the shim to the recorded value plus the doubler thickness at the affected positions.
sections.inspection_requirements: Do an eddy current inspection over the repair and the surrounding corner group at the completion of the repair and record it as the baseline. Repeat the eddy current inspection of the repaired corner at every pane replacement and in any case at every 6 000 flight cycles. A crack found beyond the repair doubler footprint invalidates this repair and must be referred to the engineering department.

type_data.allowable_damage_limits: A single crack up to 18 mm long from a fastener hole edge, with no second indication at an adjacent hole in the same corner group, and no crack that reaches the pane sealing face.

repair_drawings.title: External doubler and revised fastener pattern, windshield lower forward corner

materials.description: DOUBLER, FLIGHT COMPARTMENT WINDOWS, KIT, LOWER

type_data.fastener_pattern: Two rows: an inner structural row of 14 tension bolts at 22 mm pitch and 20 mm edge distance, and an outer row of 22 blind rivets at 18 mm pitch.
type_data.fatigue_life_note: The repair is life-limited to 20 000 flight cycles from the date of embodiment, with a repeat eddy current inspection every 6 000 flight cycles and at every pane replacement.

title: Windshield Frame Land and Outboard Doubler — Crack Repair

issue.reason: Shim base distinguished by windshield standard, because the two frame packings do not start from the same value.

abstract: Permanent repair for a crack in the windshield frame land or the outboard doubler at the lower forward corner, using an external doubler, a revised fastener pattern that clears the heater terminal and a shim base read from the fitted windshield standard.

sections.purpose: To give the permanent repair for a crack found in the windshield frame land or in the outboard doubler at the lower forward corner of a windshield aperture.
sections.damage_assessment: Cracking at this location starts at a fastener hole in the lower forward corner and runs inboard along the land. It is found at pane replacement rather than in service, because the area is covered by the pane and the trim. The heater terminal on the delivered standard sits directly in this corner and the local heat is a contributing factor; on aircraft at the relocated terminal standard the incidence is lower but the repair is the same. Assess the damage with the pane removed and the land cleaned. Measure the crack length from the hole edge. Do an eddy current inspection at every fastener hole in the corner group before deciding the repair, because a second crack at an adjacent hole changes the repair from local to full corner.
sections.repair_procedure: Remove the pane under the removal task and record the shim values by position. Remove the outboard doubler ARD967927-47 by drilling out the blind rivets to the depth on the drawing. Clean the land and remove the paint over the corner group. Do an eddy current inspection at every fastener hole in the group and mark every indication. Stop-drill the crack at its tip with the drill size on the drawing and deburr both faces. Where the crack runs from a hole, ream the hole to the first oversize and install a bushed insert to the drawing. Do an eddy current inspection at every new hole before any fastener is installed. Install the doubler D5610001982294 wet with sealant using tension bolts AES273284K7 at the structural row and blind rivets AES757493-5D at the outer row. Re-protect the whole area. Install the outboard doubler and the pane. Set the shim at the affected positions to the recorded value plus the repair doubler thickness, and take the recorded value from the position record made at removal on this aircraft, not from a nominal table: the delivered standard and the relocated heater terminal standard carry different frame packing at the lower forward corner, so the same nominal shim gives a different stack on the two. On a windshield that has been changed between standards during its life the two sides of one aperture can be at different packings, and each position is set from its own record.
sections.inspection_requirements: Do an eddy current inspection over the repair and the surrounding corner group at the completion of the repair and record it as the baseline. Repeat the eddy current inspection of the repaired corner at every pane replacement and in any case at every 6 000 flight cycles. A crack found beyond the repair doubler footprint invalidates this repair and must be referred to the engineering department.

type_data.allowable_damage_limits: A single crack up to 18 mm long from a fastener hole edge, with no second indication at an adjacent hole in the same corner group, and no crack that reaches the pane sealing face. Applicable at both windshield frame standards; the shim base differs between them and is taken from the position record.
